title: Event | May 31 · Shanghai — Foundation Models & GenAI for B2B: Future Outlook
summary: Unique Capital × Unique Research, with Chuansheng Tech and GITA, host a focused session on how foundation models and GenAI remake B2B product design, production, supply chain, marketing, and customer service — framed as a core path for industrial upgrade.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Event · May 11, 2024

Unique Capital × Unique Research, with Chuansheng Tech and GITA, host a focused session on how foundation models and GenAI remake B2B product design, production, supply chain, marketing, and customer service — framed as a core path for industrial upgrade.

Format: cases, demos, discussion — manufacturing scenarios, ops-model change, peer networking.

Speakers & topics

  • Cheng Junjie, Founder & CEO, Chuansheng Tech — “Theory Framework First: How AI Empowers B2B Marketing.” Youjie AI product director; 20+ years B2B marketing consulting; Fortune 500 + startups.
  • Lu Yue, VP, Yida Tech — “LLM- & AI-Driven Digital Employee Platforms — Port & Logistics Digitization.” SJTU Antai EMBA supply-chain chair; ex-Maersk Logistics / Kerry EAS; near-30 years SCM. Yida serves thousands of customers with next-gen digital employees + LLM hyper-automation platform.
  • Liu Yuchen, Founder & CEO, Yiyan Tech — “AI Innovation in B2B: Agent Landing & Outlook.” Ex-U.S. data-tech pre-sales/PM (Forrester case); Tencent Cloud industry AI SaaS lead; L’Oréal PPD China CDO.

Agenda

  • 14:00–14:30 Check-in
  • 14:30–15:10 Cheng — B2B marketing theory framework
  • 15:10–15:55 Lu — digital employees / port-logistics
  • 15:55–16:35 Liu — AI Agents in B2B
  • 16:35–16:45 Break
  • 16:45–17:30 Roundtable

Registration: address after successful signup (CN channel). Inventory type kept insight.

— END —
